这是一个非常简单的 ComfyUI 初学者友好的文本到图像工作流程，可与单个 HunyuanImage-2.1 GGUF 模型一起使用。

HunyuanImage-2.1 由腾讯浑源团队于 2025 年 9 月上旬正式发布，并于 9 月 8 日至 9 日左右发布了其开源权重和推理代码。该版本被广泛认为是“原生 2K”模型，这意味着它经过专门训练来处理高分辨率生成，而不会出现较小模型中常见的模糊或质量损失。虽然 2048 x 2048 的正方形尺寸确实是 1:1 纵横比的理想标准，但该模型具有高度灵活性，并针对多个 2K 等效尺寸进行了优化。例如，经典人像推荐 2:3 分辨率为 1536 x 2304，标准人像 3:4 分辨率为 1792 x 2304，16:9 宽屏电影拍摄分辨率推荐为 2560 x 1536，而 4:3 比例标准风景拍摄最佳分辨率为 2304 x 1792。来自腾讯的 HunyuanImage-2.1 原始开发者提到，使用 低于这些分辨率（例如 1024x1024）可能会导致视觉伪像或输出质量较低，但在我这一代人中，我发现结果非常可接受且很好，因为我通过此工作流程与您分享了它们。

您需要一个 Hugging Face 帐户来下载所需的文件（详情如下）。确保使用 ComfyUI 管理器或您可能拥有的任何其他缺失节点安装 ComfyUI 的 GGUF 插件，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、WAN 2.1、WAN 2.2、MagicWAN Image v2、QWEN、HiDream、KREA、Chroma、AuraFlow、Z-Image Turbo 和 Flux 的其他工作流程。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需先选择您想要的 HunyuanImage-2.1 GGUF 模型即可

#2.设置您想要的图像尺寸开始

＃3。然后输入你的正面和负面提示。

＃4。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置

＃6。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

*** 此工作流程也适用于低规格系统上的 1024 低分辨率等效项（SDXL 分辨率）

o.en:
This is a very simple ComfyUI beginner friendly Text-to-Image workflow that will work with a single HunyuanImage-2.1 GGUF model.

HunyuanImage-2.1 was officially released by Tencent's Hunyuan team in early September 2025, specifically launching its open-source weights and inference code around September 8 and 9. This version is widely recognized for being a "native 2K" model, meaning it was specifically trained to handle high-resolution generation without the common blurring or quality loss seen in smaller models. While a square size of 2048 x 2048 is indeed the ideal standard for a 1:1 aspect ratio, the model is highly flexible and optimized for several 2K-equivalent dimensions. For example, the recommended 2:3 resolution for classic portrait is 1536 x 2304, 3:4 resolution for standard portrait is 1792 x 2304, 16:9 resolution widescreen cinematic shot is 2560 x 1536, while a 4:3 ratio standard landscape shot is best at 2304 x 1792. The original developers of HunyuanImage-2.1 from Tencent mentioned that using resolutions lower than these (such as 1024x1024) may result in visual artifacts or lower quality outputs but in my generations I have found the results to be very acceptable and fine as I shared them with you with this workflow.

You need a Hugging Face account to download your necessary files (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you install GGUF addon for ComfyUI using ComfyUI manager or any other missing nodes you may have and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, WAN 2.1, WAN 2.2, MagicWAN Image v2, QWEN, HiDream, KREA, Chroma, AuraFlow, Z-Image Turbo and Flux.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired HunyuanImage-2.1 GGUF models first and now

#2. set your desired image dimensions to start

#3. then input your positive and negative prompts.

#4. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings

#6. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

*** This workflow will also function on 1024 Low res equivalents (SDXL resolutions) on low spec systems
